items.title: Concurrent author deletion can fail public build discovery
items.reproduction: Under the concurrent production browser suite, deleting fixture authors while the public build discovery query loads related author records produced Prisma required-author null and React error 441. Initial phase-five logs retained.
items.expected: A bounded gallery read returns an internally consistent snapshot while accounts/content are deleted concurrently.
items.current: Public build discovery query and its equipment/author/favorite relations execute within a RepeatableRead transaction. Existing visibility/ownership filters, page size and ordering preserved.
items.historical_cause: Related Prisma reads could observe different committed snapshots across concurrent cascade deletion.
items.verification: Installed Prisma 6.19.3 transaction types checked; full concurrent Node 22 gates after correction pass 132 unit/58 browser/15 disposable DB checks; latest browser audit has no errors. Scoped fix, not proof of all database race absence.
